players.product: Turnkey custom-chip (ASIC) design and mass-production services for AI/data-processing chips, plus licensed GPU, GPGPU, NPU and VPU processor IP

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 91.37% YoY; Q2 2026 revenue rose 75.95% YoY. By business: mass-production services revenue RMB 1.163 billion (+185.29%), design services RMB 350 million (+50.73%), IP licence fees RMB 293 million (+4.32%), IP royalties +10.85%. Data-processing applications revenue RMB 732 million (+292.17%), 39.27% of revenue. Gross margin 31.34% (down 11.98 points on revenue mix). Net loss attributable to shareholders RMB 612.1 million; adjusted net loss RMB 423 million; adjusted EBITDA RMB -222 million. 109 chips contributed mass-production revenue, with 59 more design projects awaiting mass production.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1.864 billion (+91.37%); Q2 revenue RMB 1.028 billion (+75.95%); mass production RMB 1.163 billion (+185.29%); data processing +292.17%; GM 31.34%

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog reached RMB 12.449 billion at end-June 2026, up 142.52% from RMB 5.133 billion at end-Q1, and has stayed high for 11 consecutive quarters. Mass-production service orders in the backlog exceed RMB 10 billion; over 83% of the backlog is data-processing orders, mainly from AI ASICs. Design-service orders usually take 9-12 months to convert to revenue; mass-production orders typically take 6-18 months from signing (including capacity lock-in and scheduling at partner foundries).
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog RMB 12.449 billion at 06-30-2026 (+142.52% QoQ); >83% data processing, mainly AI ASIC

quarterly_data.signal: New orders signed from January 1 to August 17, 2026 reached RMB 15.142 billion (RMB 14.653 billion through July 16), with AI-compute-related orders 90% and data-processing orders 89% of the total; most are custom-chip (design and mass-production) orders. Full-year 2025 new orders were RMB 5.96 billion; 2026 year-to-date new orders already equal 254% of that. Management expects new orders to keep a good trend.
quarterly_data.figure: New orders 01-01-2026 to 08-17-2026: 90% AI compute, 89% data processing; 254% of full-year 2025 new orders

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook: VeriSilicon expects adjusted EBITDA (excluding non-operating / non-cash costs) to turn positive in H2 2026 and adjusted net profit attributable to shareholders to turn positive for full-year 2027; it expects adjusted R&D expense as a share of revenue and of gross profit to keep falling in H2 2026 vs H1 and in 2026 vs 2025 (H1 2026 adjusted R&D/revenue already down about 20 points YoY). The company cautions the targets depend on macro, market and industry conditions.
quarterly_data.figure: Adjusted EBITDA positive H2 2026; adjusted net profit positive FY2027 (company targets)

quarterly_data.signal: Design services: 96 chip design projects in execution at period end, 22.92% of them at 7nm and below and 32.29% at 14nm and below; 36.49% of H1 design revenue came from 7nm-and-below nodes. AI-compute-related design revenue was RMB 144 million, over 41% of design revenue. Revenue from system vendors, large internet companies, cloud service providers and carmakers was RMB 555 million, about 30% of total; 16 new custom-chip customers were added in H1 (365 cumulative). The company has taped out chips at 14nm/10nm/7nm/6nm/5nm/4nm FinFET and 28nm/22nm FD-SOI.
quarterly_data.figure: 96 design projects (22.92% at 7nm and below); AI-compute design revenue RMB 144 million (>41%)

quarterly_data.signal: Chiplet / advanced packaging: VeriSilicon has designed a 2.5D CoWoS package for a customer's AIGC chip, taped out and tested a UCIe die-to-die PHY that customers have adopted, supplies GPGPU, NPU and VPU IP to a chiplet-solution leader for its chiplet-based AI chips, and is developing chiplet-based high-performance computing chip platforms for AIGC and autonomous driving; it has also pre-developed designs for panel-level packaging.

Processor IP: VeriSilicon NPU IP is used by 91 customers in more than 140 AI chips, with about 250 million NPU-integrated AI chips shipped; its GPGPU IP (fused GPU and NPU) has been adopted in high-performance AI chips for data centers with multiple architecture licences; its video transcoding solution is used by 7 of the top 20 global cloud service providers, and the second-generation transcoding platform (8K, AV1, AI, RISC-V CPU) is in mass production at a leading international chip customer.
quarterly_data.figure: NPU IP: 91 customers, 140+ chips, ~250 million chips shipped

connects_to.relationship: semiconductor IP and EDA tool licences

contracts.signal: VeriSilicon's H1 2026 report states its semiconductor IP and EDA tool suppliers in the period were mainly Synopsys and Cadence, and lists the loss of their technology licences as a risk.

VeriSilicon.why: Turnkey custom AI ASIC design and mass-production house: AI-compute orders are 90% of its 2026 new orders and data-processing (mainly AI ASIC) orders over 83% of its RMB 12.449 billion backlog, so its revenue rises directly with custom AI chip builds.
VeriSilicon.evidence: VeriSilicon half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026): order backlog RMB 12.449 billion at end-June 2026, over 83% data-processing orders mainly from AI ASICs; mass-production services revenue +185.29%.
